pages.text: Make a shelf with six slabs and a plank of the same wood. Place it facing you. Each corner of the opening is a slot.$(br2)Right-click a slot with an item to display it. Right-click with an empty hand to eject the stack.
Oak is shown here. Use a matching plank and slabs to craft other woods.

pages.title: Inventory and Drops
pages.text: Sneak-right-click empty-handed to open the inventory and move stacks between slots. Mine the shelf with an axe to recover the contents separately. The shelf keeps its wood or custom panel.
